title: Electoral Commission, NSW
summary: This page provides information about the Electoral Commission, NSW, which manages electoral processes and voter enrolment.

faqs.q: Where can I find information about voting?
faqs.a: You can find information about voting on the NSW Electoral Commission website.

faqs.q: How do I enrol to vote?
faqs.a: You can find information on enrolment on the NSW Electoral Commission website.

faqs.a: You can check your electoral boundaries and districts on the NSW Electoral Commission website.
